# Review return: review-495aedda2e31ad59

Both assigned targets now have complete reviewer-side native parametric builds.  The canonical selected program is preserved byte-for-byte in each default setting; the nondefault setting adds a genuine input-dependent A → intermediate → B dependency.

## e89e3ed7cb28

Built `bottommost` / `modal_survivor_color`.  Stage A is the canonical bottommost cell per active column; the survivor histogram selects a color; stage B filters the original grid to that color.  The sampler makes the whole-grid modal color different and includes selected-color cells above nonselected survivors.  Focused and packet tests passed, the bounded protected-Racket probe checked 12 episodes and 24 shortcut disagreements, authoring preflight executed 32 Racket labels, and the wrong-intermediate witness replayed.

## edf83166c155

First repaired the retained scaffold shortcut: the ordinary schedule now places the symmetric target in all four quadrants, and the regression reproduces the old rival and requires disagreement.  Then built `symmetric_object` / `successor_of_symmetric`.  Stage A finds the unique LR-symmetric object; its color is the intermediate; stage B crops the cyclic successor-colored object.  Focused and packet tests passed (16 total), the protected probe checked 12 episodes with all key/partner quadrants and 18/15 shortcut disagreements, authoring preflight executed 32 Racket labels, and the wrong-intermediate witness replayed.

Both contracts support 2–6 demonstrations and exactly four distinct queries, including substantive 30×30 stress.  Single-query public projections verified 16 views per target and first-turn private-field invariance passed 24 checks per target.  These are bounded authoring checks only: owner integration, native qualification, exact-source acceptance, and any training admission remain pending.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: Read the color of that unique LR-symmetric key object.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Find the unique 4-connected object whose bbox-normalized binary mask is invariant under left/right reflection.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Advance the key color by one on the cyclic 1..9 palette (9 wraps to 1), then crop the unique object having that successor color.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Key position, shape, and color vary independently across the episode. In this case the symmetric key is color 5, so B must derive color 6; replacing the intermediate with 1 selects the existing color-2 decoy and changes the final crop.
